description: One engine at one knowledge base: which it is, the jobs it claims, and what its claims can say of themselves (WORKER-CONTRACT V1).

jobs.description: The jobs it claims, as its claims state them.

lastQueuedEventAt.description: When a `job:queued` last reached it, or null.

lastClaimAt.description: When it was last handed a job, or null. A claim answered with none pending is not one.

lastFinishedAt.description: When a job it held last settled, or null.

lastActivityAt.description: When it was last active, or null.

activeJob.description: The job it holds, or null.

since.description: When it was handed the job.

jobsCompleted.description: How many jobs it has completed since the service started.
